title: Efficacy of Lactobacillus Reuteri Protectis on Functional Abdominal Pain (FAP) in Children 8-14 Years Old
brief_summary: The present clinical trial will examine the use of L. reuteri Protectis in children with functional abdominal pain. The aim of the study is to evaluate the use of L. reuteri Protectis on pain (severity and frequency) in children of 8-14 years old and with diagnosis of functional abdominal pain (FAP).
